name: ok0-claude-code-plugins
description: Reusable Claude Code agent collections — multi-agent workflows for structured development

plugins.name: duo
plugins.description: A two-agent workflow (architect → editor) separating design and implementation. Uses opus for complex planning and haiku for mechanical edits to save tokens.

plugins.name: trio
plugins.description: A three-agent workflow (planner → architect → editor) adding a planning layer before design and implementation. The planner clarifies vague requests into structured specs before any code is read.

plugins.name: quartet
plugins.description: A four-agent workflow (planner → architect → editor → verifier) that closes the loop with an independent verifier. The verifier checks every acceptance criterion and routes failures back to the right agent. Orchestrated by the /quartet command.
